methods.selection: Every supplied run and peer retained. Select the unique sampledAt maximum of formalWithEndBoundary new states; do not substitute maximum RAF timestamp.
methods.request: Game identity comes from retained onGameFrame records linked by rafIndex. Parent record, clean request/callback flags, verified hooks and ordered finite Page performance.now timestamps are required.
methods.waiting: Eligible start is max(requestedAt,parent.exitedAt). Clip [eligibleAt,enteredAt] to the same-page absolute sampledAt gap; merge overlaps once. This observes registered, parent-returned RAF waiting, not a guaranteed browser deadline or OS, thread, GPU or network causality.
methods.coverage: Only retained game-frame-linked requests are enumerated. Unknown records remain and are never zero-filled. Pause fields are requested states, not native state reads; controls and hook/error records are retained.
methods.native: Sum whole sample[2] callback costs for (fromSample,toSample], separately from wait union. Includes synchronous bridges and may contain zero/multiple ticks; no wall-minus-native residual or scheduler attribution is computed.
methods.clock: sampledAt is a post-native observation, not observer return or physical scanout. No cross-page, relay or host clock subtraction.
